$comment: What the static checks of a helper body find (docs/language/08-diagnostics.md), in every branch. Both implementations run it: src/Ample.Language (NoteLangCorpusTests.Static_checks) and web/lib/note-lang.mjs (web/lib/test/note-lang.test.mjs). 'issues' are the ids of the new checks only (undefined-name, type-mismatch, no-value, unused-variable, no-effect), sorted; a trailing ! means the issue is an error (strict).
